log.msg: Board reworked: intro prose gone, .ai-cards grid -> .ai-list column, board.js draws the time spine (heading only where the label changes), card carries its effort as a tag, /framework/ai/effort/<slug>/ filters. Running tasks now appear ONCE (the strip is the listing, not a pin over the effort groups) — effort_groups() and dots() deleted.

Two bugs found on the way. (1) Task order was string-compared, and logs carry both ...Z and ...-05:00 stamps — a UTC landed_at sorted five hours late, so 12:22 PM sat above 12:34 PM. Now Date.parse'd, in board.js/dashboard.js/effort.js. (2) Removing the prose exposed a latent catalog bug: ai.css flips the catalog to a column but catalog.css's align-items:flex-start then shrink-wrapped the pages region to 52px, breaking the 'AI' title across two lines. Fixed with align-self:stretch.

Verified headless at 560/1600/3440: 75 cards, 0 grids, dot centre matches the title's first line to the pixel, /framework/ai/effort/nope/ says so honestly, no console errors on the board, a day, either effort page or the AITask doc demos.

assign.outcome: **The board is a time spine.** [/framework/ai/](/framework/ai/) — intro prose gone, the card grid replaced by one card per row, every card headed by its time (today) or its weekday (SATURDAY, and the date too past a week), active above, dormant below. Each card wears its effort as a tag linking to [/framework/ai/effort/<slug>/](/framework/ai/effort/ai-log/), a new route() that filters the same spine. Status dot now centres on the title's first line to the pixel. New file: ext/AITask/board.js; effort_groups() and dots() deleted — a running task is listed once, not pinned over a duplicate.
